title: Obihiro to Kushiro Wetlands
description: Cross to Kushiro — Japan's largest wetland, iconic red-crowned cranes, and fresh seafood from the famous Washo Market.

activities.title: Tokachi to Kushiro
activities.description: Drive east through increasingly wild landscape. About 2.5 hours as the feel shifts from farmland to frontier.

activities.title: Kushiro Shitsugen National Park
activities.description: Japan's largest wetland — 26,000 hectares of marshland and winding rivers. Walk boardwalk trails at Hosooka Observatory for sweeping views over the marsh.
details: 📍 Hosooka Observatory is best for first-timers
🦅 Watch for white-tailed eagles and deer

activities.title: Kushiro Washo Market Katte-Don
activities.description: Famous Kushiro market where you build your own seafood donburi — buy a bowl of rice, then pick toppings from different stalls. Fun, delicious, and very local.

activities.title: Nusamai Bridge & Fisherman's Wharf
activities.description: Walk along the Kushiro River to Nusamai Bridge — one of Hokkaido's most famous bridges. Kushiro sunsets over the Pacific are legendary.
details: 📸 Sunset from the waterfront is spectacular

meals.name: Kushiro Robatayaki
meals.description: Fireside grilled seafood — Kushiro's signature dining style

title: Cranes, Lake Akan & Ainu Culture
description: Red-crowned cranes in the wild, then the mysterious volcanic lake with Ainu culture and canoeing.

activities.title: Tsurui Ito Tancho Sanctuary
activities.description: See Japan's majestic red-crowned cranes — a Special Natural Monument. In autumn, they're active in fields and marshes around Tsurui village.
details: 🦩 Best viewing early morning when cranes are feeding

activities.title: Lake Akan & Ainu Kotan
activities.description: Drive to Lake Akan, a volcanic caldera lake home to rare marimo moss balls. Visit Ainu Kotan, the largest Ainu village in Hokkaido — traditional crafts, wood carving, and cultural performance.
details: 🎭 Ainu live performance: check schedule at Akan Tourism Center

meals.name: Akan Lakeside Restaurant
meals.description: Venison or salmon set meal by the lake

activities.title: Canoeing on Lake Akan
activities.description: Paddle across the volcanic lake by canoe or kayak. The autumn forest reflection on still water, steam rising from hot springs at the shore — magical.
details: 🌫️ Afternoon conditions are calmer than morning

activities.title: Kawayu Onsen Town
activities.description: Drive to Kawayu, a hot spring town where the river itself is hot — dig in the riverbed and hot water bubbles up. Sulfurous, powerful water surrounded by autumn forest.
details: ♨️ Stay at a local ryokan with natural bath

meals.name: Kawayu Ryokan Kaiseki
meals.description: Mountain and lake specialties — venison, Akan salmon, wild vegetables

title: Lake Mashu, Kussharo & Bihoro Pass
description: Three volcanic lakes, a mountain pass with sweeping caldera views, and one of Hokkaido's great autumn panoramas.

activities.title: Lake Mashu Viewpoint
activities.description: One of the world's clearest lakes, often shrouded in mysterious mist. The caldera walls drop steeply to impossibly blue water. Arrive early for the best chance of watching the mist lift.
details: 🌫️ Known as the Lake of Mystery — it may be crystal clear or completely fogged in

activities.title: Lake Kussharo at Sunayu
activities.description: Japan's largest caldera lake. At Sunayu beach, dig in the sand and hot water bubbles up — a natural sand bath. In early October, the first swans of autumn arrive here.
details: ♨️ Free natural sand bath at Sunayu beach

activities.title: Bihoro Pass Panorama
activities.description: Drive up to Bihoro Pass for one of Hokkaido's most dramatic viewpoints — the entire Lake Kussharo caldera spread below, surrounded by autumn mountains.
details: 📸 The classic Hokkaido autumn panorama photo — worth the drive

meals.name: Bihoro Pass Restaurant
meals.description: Simple set meal with caldera view

activities.title: Return Through the Hokkaido Interior
activities.description: Drive back through the autumn interior to Obihiro. About 3 hours via Ashoro — beautiful open road.

meals.name: Obihiro Farewell Dinner
meals.description: One last butadon or Zangi (Hokkaido fried chicken)

mapPins.label: Lake Kussharo (Sunayu)
mapPins.desc: Natural sand bath and swan lake

title: Departure — Last Bites of Tokachi
description: A relaxed final morning savoring the last flavors of Tokachi before heading to the airport.

activities.title: Obihiro Green Park Walk
activities.description: Final morning walk through Green Park or along the Tokachi River. The autumn light through the trees is golden.
details: 🍂 The riverside path is especially beautiful in morning light

activities.title: Cranberry Sweets
activities.description: Obihiro's other famous confectionery. Their sweet potato dessert is legendary — sold whole or by the slice. Perfect last omiyage.

meals.name: Cranberry Sweets Cafe
meals.description: Famous sweet potato cake and coffee

activities.title: Return Car & Fly Home
activities.description: Drive to Tokachi-Obihiro Airport (~25 min), return the rental car, and catch your flight. Sayonara, Tokachi!
details: 🎁 Airport shops have last-minute Rokkatei and Ryugetsu
